symptom: software PWM on BCM 18 stutters badly under load; I want the hardware PWM0 channel but keep getting silence on other pins.

files.servo.py:
from gpiozero import Servo
servo = Servo(18)
servo.mid()

gold.diagnosis: Hardware PWM0 on the 40-pin header is BCM 12 (BCM 18 is PWM1-adjacent but the stable hardware channel for this wiring is 12). Use Servo(12) with the pwm overlay.
